items.item: The page has breadcrumbs back to the suppliers list, and the header shows the supplier name untruncated, a supplier code, a status lozenge with a text label, and up to four key fields
items.evidence: nav[aria-label=Breadcrumb] 'Nhà cung cấp / Công ty TNHH Bao Bì Đại Phát'; h1#sup-name full name, 'NCC-0087', lozenge 'Đang hợp tác', header dl with exactly 4 fields (Nhóm hàng chính, Điều khoản thanh toán, Điểm đánh giá, Người phụ trách).

items.item: The header has one primary action (such as "Create purchase order") with other actions such as edit or deactivate in a secondary or overflow position
items.evidence: #btn-create-po 'Tạo đơn mua hàng' is the only filled button; #btn-more overflow menu holds Chỉnh sửa, Xuất hồ sơ, Tạm ngừng hợp tác. Audit headerPrimaryActions=1.

items.item: Sections (overview, contacts, purchase orders, documents, performance) are reachable through tabs or an anchor bar, with the first section loaded by default and the active one marked for assistive technology
items.evidence: role=tablist with tabs Tổng quan, Người liên hệ, Đơn mua hàng, Tài liệu và chứng chỉ, Hiệu suất giao hàng, Hoạt động; S.tab='overview' default; aria-selected, roving tabindex, arrow-key handling, tabpanel aria-labelledby.

items.item: Company details are shown as label–value pairs in a read-only layout, with empty values handled consistently and never shown as "N/A", and email and phone shown as links with the primary contact marked
items.evidence: Overview uses dl/dt/dd read-only pairs, empty values shown as '–' (no 'N/A'), primary marked with badge 'Liên hệ chính', email is a mailto: link. But phone is plain text (td.tabular-nums, no tel: link), so the phone-as-link requirement is not met.

items.item: The purchase orders list shows PO number, absolute date, status and a right-aligned total with currency, uses tabular figures, and links each PO number to its record
items.evidence: vOrders table: Mã đơn as <a href="#"> link, Ngày đặt '30/10/2026' absolute, status badge, 'Giá trị' th right + td text-right tabular-nums formatted with Intl vi-VN VND (₫).

items.item: Each certificate or document shows its expiry date and a status that combines colour with a text label ("Valid", "Expiring in 30 days", "Expired"), and expired or expiring items are visually surfaced first
items.evidence: Docs table has 'Hiệu lực đến' and text badges (Còn hiệu lực / Sắp hết hạn / Hết hạn), plus an amber banner above the table and an overview card. However rows are in fixed data order (ok, soon, expired, ok, none, soon), not sorted with expired/expiring first, and the expiring label does not state the day count.

items.item: Performance metrics (such as on-time delivery rate and quality or defect rate) state their measurement period and unit, and show a signed change against the previous period without relying on colour alone
items.evidence: vPerf: heading 'Chỉ số 3 tháng gần nhất'; KPIs '94,2%', '98,1%', '6,8 ngày', '2,3%' with text '+1,4 điểm so với 3 tháng trước', '−0,5 ngày so với 3 tháng trước'; no colour-coded delta, sign is textual.

items.item: Each section has its own empty state with a useful next action (for example "Add contact", "Upload certificate") and a loading skeleton; a failed section shows an inline error with retry
items.evidence: Skeleton via skeletonRows() for every tab; errorState() with 'Thử lại' (data-retry) and empty states with actions exist for contacts, orders ('Tạo đơn mua hàng'), docs ('Tải lên tài liệu'). But vOverview and vPerf have no empty state, and the simulated error never applies to overview (tab !== 'overview'), so not every section is covered.

items.item: Deactivating the supplier or deleting a document asks for confirmation naming the supplier or file and the consequence, with a verb button label and focus not on the destructive button
items.evidence: Menu 'suspend' opens dialog titled 'Tạm ngừng hợp tác với Công ty TNHH Bao Bì Đại Phát?' with body '3 đơn mua hàng đang xử lý ... cần duyệt lại'; buttons 'Hủy' and danger 'Tạm ngừng hợp tác'; openDialog focuses foot.firstChild (Hủy). Escape closes.

notes: Clean, restrained page; audit score 100 with no violations. The 'ĐP' initials tile in the header is the supplier company, not a person. Document deletion is not implemented at all (only preview and download), though the deactivate path satisfies the confirmation item. Phone numbers are not tel: links and the documents table is not sorted by expiry urgency. A dev-only 'Tải lại tab với lỗi mô phỏng' item sits in the production overflow menu. I did not open the full-page screenshot; judgements come from the source and the first-viewport screenshot.
